output_list.reason: The 'create' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It adds a large amount to the balances of the caller, which can overflow and cause a denial of service to users.
The 'batchTransfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It adds a large value to multiple users' balances, which can overflow and cause a denial of service to users.
The 'transferFrom' function allows the owner to transfer tokens to any address, which can be exploited to create a vulnerability where a user's tokens are frozen.
The 'setFightsAddress' function allows the owner to set the 'fights' address, which can be exploited to create a vulnerability where attackers can gain control over the user's assets.
The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It adds a large amount to the balances of the recipient, which can overflow and cause a denial of service to users.
